GRADE 4 SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Time: 64 minutes

INSTRUCTIONS
1. Answer all questions.
2. Use neat handwriting.
2. For multiple choice, write the correct letter only.
3. For short answers, write clearly in the spaces provided.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A: Multiple Choice

1. About Compass Direction in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. identify the four cardinal points of a compass,
   B. Learners should ignore Compass Direction completely.
   C. Compass Direction is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Compass Direction.

2. About Compass Direction around your home, which statement is correct?
   A. use the four cardinal points to give directions on a map,
   B. Learners should ignore Compass Direction completely.
   C. Compass Direction is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Compass Direction.

3. About Compass Direction in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. identify the four cardinal points of a compass,
   B. Learners should ignore Compass Direction completely.
   C. Compass Direction is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Compass Direction.

5. About Location and size of the County at the market in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. identify sub-counties in the county,
   B. Learners should ignore Location and size of the County completely.
   C. Location and size of the County is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Location and size of the County.

6. About Location and size of the County using objects in your classroom, which statement is correct?
   A. locate the county in relation to neighbouring counties,
   B. Learners should ignore Location and size of the County completely.
   C. Location and size of the County is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Location and size of the County.

7. About Location and size of the County when counting items at home, which statement is correct?
   A. estimate the size of the county in relation to neighbouring counties,
   B. Learners should ignore Location and size of the County completely.
   C. Location and size of the County is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Location and size of the County.

9. About Physical features in the County at the market in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. identify the main physical features in the county,
   B. Learners should ignore Physical features in the County completely.
   C. Physical features in the County is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Physical features in the County.

10. About Physical features in the County using objects in your classroom, which statement is correct?
   A. state the importance of the main physical features in the county,
   B. Learners should ignore Physical features in the County completely.
   C. Physical features in the County is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Physical features in the County.

11. About Physical features in the County when counting items at home, which statement is correct?
   A. illustrate the main physical features in the county,
   B. Learners should ignore Physical features in the County completely.
   C. Physical features in the County is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Physical features in the County.

13. About Seasons in the County at the market in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. identify the four seasons experienced in the county,
   B. Learners should ignore Seasons in the County completely.
   C. Seasons in the County is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Seasons in the County.

14. About Seasons in the County using objects in your classroom, which statement is correct?
   A. explain how the four seasons influence human activities in the county,
   B. Learners should ignore Seasons in the County completely.
   C. Seasons in the County is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Seasons in the County.

15. About Seasons in the County when counting items at home, which statement is correct?
   A. explore how rainy weather affects road safety in the county,
   B. Learners should ignore Seasons in the County completely.
   C. Seasons in the County is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Seasons in the County.

17. About Historic Built Environments in the County at the market in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. identify the main historic built environments in the county,
   B. Learners should ignore Historic Built Environments in the County completely.
   C. Historic Built Environments in the County is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Historic Built Environments in the County.

18. About Historic Built Environments in the County using objects in your classroom, which statement is correct?
   A. explain the importance of the main historic built environments in the county,
   B. Learners should ignore Historic Built Environments in the County completely.
   C. Historic Built Environments in the County is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Historic Built Environments in the County.

19. About Historic Built Environments in the County when counting items at home, which statement is correct?
   A. participate in conservation activities of the historic built environments within the county,
   B. Learners should ignore Historic Built Environments in the County completely.
   C. Historic Built Environments in the County is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Historic Built Environments in the County.

21. About Interdependence of people in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. identify ways in which people depend on each other in the county,
   B. Learners should ignore Interdependence of people completely.
   C. Interdependence of people is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Interdependence of people.

22. About Interdependence of people around your home, which statement is correct?
   A. explain the benefits of interdependence of people in the county,
   B. Learners should ignore Interdependence of people completely.
   C. Interdependence of people is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Interdependence of people.

23. About Interdependence of people in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. use chart to illustrate the benefits of interdependence people,
   B. Learners should ignore Interdependence of people completely.
   C. Interdependence of people is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Interdependence of people.

25. About Population Distribution in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. describe patterns of population distribution in the county,
   B. Learners should ignore Population Distribution completely.
   C. Population Distribution is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Population Distribution.

26. About Population Distribution around your home, which statement is correct?
   A. illustrate the patterns of population distribution in the county,
   B. Learners should ignore Population Distribution completely.
   C. Population Distribution is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Population Distribution.

27. About Population Distribution in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. describe patterns of population distribution in the county,
   B. Learners should ignore Population Distribution completely.
   C. Population Distribution is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Population Distribution.

29. About Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. at the market in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. identify aspects of traditional culture in the county,
   B. Learners should ignore Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. completely.
   C. Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County..

30. About Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. using objects in your classroom, which statement is correct?
   A. illustrate aspects of traditional culture practised in the county,
   B. Learners should ignore Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. completely.
   C. Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County..

31. About Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. when counting items at home, which statement is correct?
   A. identify aspects of traditional culture in the county,
   B. Learners should ignore Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. completely.
   C. Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County..

SECTION B: Short Answers

8. Give two examples of how you can use Location and size of the County at the market in your county.

12. Give two examples of how you can use Physical features in the County at the market in your county.

16. Give two examples of how you can use Seasons in the County at the market in your county.

20. Give two examples of how you can use Historic Built Environments in the County at the market in your county.

24. Give two examples of how you can use Interdependence of people in your school compound.

28. Give two examples of how you can use Population Distribution in your school compound.

32. Give two examples of how you can use Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. at the market in your county.
